spec: Agent Messaging §7.3.1, Updates a Transport Does Not Carry
comment: A view of a Task that a transport does not show every update of (a requester over email, a caller over A2A) fills a gap only through submitted and working. Each case gives the last state the view saw (null for none) and the state of the update it receives. 'applies' says whether the view takes the update; 'passed_through' lists, in order, the states it takes as passed through but not seen. A refused update is TASK_INVALID_TRANSITION. lib/check-unseen-states.mjs runs every case against a reference reading of the rule.
